trajair.explanation: Calibration pools every retained track slot once; this pool samples now slots 59,74,89,... and shifts each history to its latest received slot j. Histories overlap, require j>=59, can repeat for different now slots, and measure loss only in slots 0..58. Thus track weighting, boundaries, and conditioning on a received endpoint differ. Bursts are pooled within-history lost runs, including left-boundary truncation. Integer slot age n-j differs from calibration's continuous, right-endpoint-exclusive window age and logged snapshot Age. These are empirical reception gaps, not identified RF packet losses.
